method: Freezer admission (scripts/freeze_dps_ranking.py) through the comparison follow-up register; the golden test re-enumerates every row from raw pages without freezer, analyzer or metric code. A row is consistent when |ranked * 1000 / duration - published| < 10^-(published decimals) and the ranking duration equals the fight duration. Damage to the production-excluded target game IDs is subtracted; the boss's list witnesses are re-proved to match with the list and to contradict without it.
